Five situations with their own tempo: calm 70, docked 62, tension 96, combat 132, boss 144 bpm. detect() reads the game every 900 ms (P.docked; hostile distance against HOSTILE_NEAR 260 / HOSTILE_SEEN 900; a hostile at 2x the player's maxHp is boss; hull loss latches combat for 6 s). Fully procedural - oscillators and shaped noise on the AudioContext SOUND already owns - so it downloads nothing. MEASURED in the live page: all five situations reached their layer targets and their tempos (e.g. combat sub 0.515/0.52 perc 0.437/0.44 at 132 bpm; boss 0.619/0.62 at 144; calm sub 0 perc 0 at 70), ctx.state running, MUSIC.auto() handing control back to the detector.
